verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI has no documented sandbox or test mode, but its features support isolated testing. It can process raw HTML (`raw:`) or local files (`file://`) instead of live sites. It also offers an interactive playground for testing requests and a self-hosted Docker server that keeps test runs off shared infrastructure. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment feature, documented guidance on separating test from production crawls, mock/fixture targets, independent corroboration of sandbox-style testing workflows.
